contracts: (Lease storage shows no lease created after disablement and queue outcome is denied or cancelled.) AND (Lease storage shows no lease created after revocation and queue outcome is denied or cancelled.) AND (The production queue records cancellation or drain and no dispatch event exists for the revoked item.)
selector_intents: PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests dispatches through HeavyRunnerQueueService after Account disablement and detects creation of a new write lease.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests dispatches through HeavyRunnerQueueService after credential revocation and detects creation of a new write lease.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests uses HeavyRunnerQueueService dispatch after credential revocation and detects dispatch instead of cancellation or drain.
